in the normalization with gradient coefficient 1/κ², quartic (1/2)(1−f²)², and field B², the density at κ² = 1/2 is (√2 f' − a f)² + (B + (1−f²)/√2)² minus √2 times the derivative of a(1−f²). the chain rule along E = Δ cosh t pulls the coherence-factor integrand back to sech t for t > 0. ∫₀^T sech = arctan(sinh T), and the limit T → ∞ is π/2. the weak-coupling excess free energy F = N(0) (T−T_c)/T_c · Δ² + 7 ζ N(0)/(16 π² T_c²) · Δ⁴ is a hypothesis, with k_B = 1. Its minimum is −α₀² (T−T_c)²/(4 β), and −T ∂²F/∂T² at T_c is ΔC = T_c α₀²/(2 β) = 8 π² N(0) T_c/(7 ζ). The normal heat capacity C_n = (2 π²/3) N(0) T_c is the both-spin Sommerfeld value, a hypothesis. The ratio is 12/(7 ζ). ζ is the quartic coefficient, not a series evaluation. the Boltzmann tails n = N_c exp(−(E_c−μ)/(k_B T)) and p = N_v exp(−(μ−E_v)/(k_B T)), with E_g = E_c − E_v, multiply to N_c N_v exp(−E_g/(k_B T)). That product is the square of n_i = √(N_c N_v) exp(−E_g/(2 k_B T)). Dropping the 2 in the exponent is a different density. The tails are hypotheses. Not a Fermi–Dirac integral

the undamped oscillator ε(ω) = ε(∞) + S/(ω_TO² − ω²) has a zero at ω_LO, which fixes S, and ε(0) is the same function at zero frequency. The ratio is ω_LO²/ω_TO² = ε(0)/ε(∞). The unsquared frequency ratio fails when ω_LO ≠ ω_TO. No damping is a hypothesis

the phase gradient of a θ = φ vortex integrates to π J ln(R/a) between the core and radius R. The entropy hypothesis is the area of core positions, S = k_B ln((R/a)²) = 2 k_B ln(R/a). The free energy E − T S vanishes at a radius past the core only when k_B T = π J/2. Circumference entropy unbinds at π J. J is the stiffness in the vortex energy. Not the renormalization-group flow

a one-dimensional mode of speed v in a length L has density of states L/(h v) per spin, and the flux times v/L cancels to 1/h. Not the Hall conductance and not Landauer erasure

cold ions, with n_i(φ) = n0 / sqrt(1 − 2 e φ/(m u0²)) and Boltzmann electrons, have edge slopes whose ratio is at least 1 only when u0² ≥ k_B T_e / m_i. The sound-speed root is the non-negative one. γ_i = 3, from p ∝ n³, is the nested warmSound object and is not γ_i = 5/3. Not a kinetic sheath

the be-69 quartic with k_∥ = k cos θ is a hypothesis. The phase-speed squares are ½[c_s² + v_A² ± sqrt((c_s² + v_A²)² − 4 c_s² v_A² cos²θ)] for c_s², v_A² ≥ 0. a steady z-pinch with B = μ0 I/(2 π r), dI/dr = 2 π r j, and dp/dr = −j B cancels off the axis in d/dr[π r² p + μ0 I²/(8 π)]. Differentiability through the axis is a hypothesis. equalTemperature.covers: N_e = N_i = N and T_e = T_i = T read the Bennett integral as 2 N k_B T, so I = sqrt(16 π N k_B T / μ0) for I ≥ 0. The factor 8 is the single-population current

entries.covers: μ = m v_⊥²/(2 B) and the kinetic energy are constant along a field line. Parallel speed vanishes at the mirror, so sin² θ_lc = B0/Bm = 1/R_m with R_m = Bm/B0. Pitch-angle scattering is not this statement

μ = m v_⊥²/(2 B) and the grad-B speed μ |∇B|/(q B) give m v_⊥² |∇B|/(2 q B²). Vacuum low-β curvature uses κ = |∇B|/B, so the curvature speed is m v_∥² |∇B|/(q B²) and the sum is m (v_∥² + v_⊥²/2) |∇B|/(q B²). steady q E + q v × B = 0 with B along z gives v_x = E_y/B and v_y = −E_x/B for q ≠ 0 and B ≠ 0. The opposite charge has the same solution. Not a finite-Larmor-radius drift

the Maxwellian f = n/(v_t sqrt(2π)) exp(−v²/(2 v_t²)) has slope −(v/v_t²) f. The residue formula γ = (π ω³/(2 n k²)) (∂f/∂v)|_{ω/k} is a hypothesis, not a contour integral, and gives γ = −sqrt(π/8) ω (ω/(k v_t))³ exp(−ω²/(2 k² v_t²)). bohmGross.covers: ω² = ω_p² (1 + 3 k² λ_D²) and λ_D² = v_t²/ω_p² give ω²/(2 k² v_t²) = 3/2 + 1/(2 k² λ_D²). This does not set ω = ω_p

entries.covers: N_D = (4π/3) n λ_D³. The Rutherford b_90 = e²/(4π ε0 μ v_rel²), at (1/2) μ v_rel² = (3/2) k_B T, is e²/(12 π ε0 k_B T). Then Λ = λ_D/b_90 = 12 π n λ_D³ = 9 N_D. The one-species Debye length is an input. The angular integral and ln Λ are not evaluated

two linearized Boltzmann responses and Poisson give 1/λ_D² = 1/λ₁² + 1/λ₂², with λ_s² = ε0 k_B T_s/(n_s q_s²). Dropping a responding species leaves a different length. The one-species length is not restated

σ_tr = 4π b0² ln Λ is a hypothesis, with b0 = Z e²/(4π ε0 m v²). At v_T² = 2 k_B T/m, ν(v_T) = n_i Z² e⁴ ln Λ √2 / (16 π ε0² √m (k_B T √(k_B T))). The conductivity moment σ = (8/√π) n_e e²/(m ν(v_T)) is a hypothesis, not the Gaussian integral. With n_e = Z n_i it gives η = (π √(2π)/8) Z e² √m ln Λ / ((4π ε0)² (k_B T √(k_B T))). entries.covers: η_m = 1/(μ0 σ) and ∂B/∂t = η_m ∂²B/∂x² are hypotheses. The slab mode B0 sin(π x/L) exp(−t/τ) decays at τ = μ0 σ L²/π². A denominator 4π is not π². Rm and the Lundquist number are the nested lundquist object. Not the Reynolds analogy

the CGL root ω² = (k_∥²/ρ) (B²/μ0 + p_⊥ − p_∥) is a hypothesis. It is negative iff p_∥ − p_⊥ > B²/μ0. With β = 2 μ0 p/B², the be-76 definition and not the solenoid hypotheses of beta_eq, the threshold is β_∥ − β_⊥ > 2. The CGL closure is not derived. be-76 does not prove this inequality

both sidewalls give C = 2 n ε h x / g. Voltage-controlled coenergy (1/2) C V² has lateral force (1/2) V² dC/dx, so the sidewall 2 and the coenergy 1/2 cancel and F = n ε h V² / g. One sidewall leaves the 1/2. Not the normal pull-in of be-79

ln(I2/I1) = e (ψ2 − ψ1)/(k_B T) and the capacitive divider ψ2 − ψ1 = C_ox/(C_ox + C_d) (Vg2 − Vg1). One decade, I2/I1 = 10, gives S = ln(10) (k_B T/e) (1 + C_d/C_ox). Dropping C_d is not the swing when C_d ≠ 0. Not the ideal diode of be-82
ideal continuous-conduction volt-second balance Vin D + (Vin − Vout)(1 − D) = 0 gives Vout/Vin = 1/(1 − D) for D ≠ 1. No real duty equals both this ratio and the buck ratio D

the momentum jump −c Δv + Δp/ρ = 0 is Δp = ρ c Δv. Fluid compressibility dρ/ρ = dp/K and thin-wall hoop strain dA/A = dp D/(E e_wall) give c = √(K/ρ) / √(1 + (K/E)(D/e_wall)). the coaxial field λ/(2 π ε r) integrates to ΔV = (λ/(2 π ε)) ln(b/a), so C' = λ/ΔV = 2 π ε / ln(b/a). Dropping 2 π is not this capacitance. Not a parallel-plate ε A/d

m ẍ + c ẋ + k x = 0 has ω = √(k/m) and linear coefficient c/m = 2 ζ ω, so ζ = c / (2 √(k m)). For c ≥ 0 the discriminant (c/m)² − 4 (k/m) vanishes iff ζ = 1. Dropping the 2 is not this ratio. √(k/m) is not ζ

the Bose integral I = ζ(3/2) √π/4 is a hypothesis, the same kind as π⁴/15 in be-90. The quadratic measure 1/(2 π²) (k_B T/D)^{3/2} times that integral is ζ(3/2) (k_B T/(4 π D))^{3/2}. entries.covers: two spins, k³ = 3 π² n, and E = ℏ² k²/(2 m) give n = (1/(3 π²)) (2 m E/ℏ²)^{3/2}. Differentiating E^{3/2} gives g(E) = (1/(2 π²)) (2 m/ℏ²)^{3/2} √E and g = (3/2) n/E. One spin replaces 1/(2 π²) by 1/(4 π²)

φ = φ0 exp(−k x) has second derivative k² φ. δn = g(E_F) e φ and Poisson φ'' = e δn/ε0 give k_TF² = e² g(E_F)/ε0. g(E_F) = (3/2) n/E_F is PhysJS.FermiSea.dos_factor, not a proof of the be-135 prefactor, so k_TF² = (e²/ε0) (3 n)/(2 E_F). complete ionization and Boltzmann tails N_D = n_i exp(e (φ_n − φ_i)/(k_B T)) and N_A = n_i exp(−e (φ_p − φ_i)/(k_B T)) give V_bi = (k_B T/e) ln(N_A N_D/n_i²). A = (2 π e B/ℏ) (n + γ) at n and at n + 1. The step is 1, so γ cancels and F = ℏ A/(2 π e), with Δ(1/B) = 1/F. Dropping γ on one orbit is not a step of 1

I = I_c sin φ and V = (ℏ/(2 e)) dφ/dt. At φ = 0, cos φ = 1, so V = L dI/dt gives L_J = ℏ/(2 e I_c). Φ₀ = h/(2 e) and h = 2 π ℏ give L_J = Φ₀/(2 π I_c). A phase with cos φ ≠ 1 is not this inductance. Not the frequency of be-59

the core cutoff is the hypothesis that j(r) = Φ₀/(2 π μ0 λ² r) on ξ ≤ r ≤ λ. The London kinetic energy integrates to (Φ₀²/(4 π μ0 λ²)) ln(λ/ξ). B_c1 = μ0 ε/Φ₀ gives B_c1 = (Φ₀/(4 π λ²)) ln(λ/ξ), with Φ₀ = h/(2 e). An additive constant under the logarithm changes the field and not the prefactor. Not be-96

the antiderivative of exp(−a s) cos(b s) is proved, and the improper integral is a/(a² + b²). At a = 1/τ and b = ω, (σ₀/τ) times that integral is σ₀/(1 + ω² τ²). σ₀ = n e² τ/m is an input. Dropping the DC 1 is not this conductivity. Not be-123

independent Poisson processes have exp(−t/τ) = exp(−t/τ₁) exp(−t/τ₂), so 1/τ = 1/τ₁ + 1/τ₂. One Drude factor ρ_i = C/τ_i makes ρ = ρ₁ + ρ₂. One lifetime is not the parallel sum. Not a collision integral

χ = χ_P ∑_n (I g(E_F))^n. For |I g(E_F)| < 1 the geometric series is 1/(1 − I g(E_F)), so χ = χ_P/(1 − I g(E_F)). The pole 1 − I g(E_F) = 0 is the same formula as I g(E_F) = 1. χ_P is be-94 and is not re-proved. The first two bubbles are not the closed form

the exponent p = 4 is a hypothesis. n_s/n = 1 − (T/T_c)^p and the London depths of be-75, not re-proved, give λ(T) = λ(0)/√(1 − (T/T_c)^4). The exponent 2 is not 4 when the reduced temperature is neither 0 nor 1. Not a BCS gap and not a second proof of be-75
k = A exp(−Ea/(R T)) with R = N_A k_B is the molecular factor exp(−ε/(k_B T)) at ε = Ea/N_A. The prefactor A is temperature-independent here. Not the Eyring identification of A

k = (k_B T/h) exp(−ΔG‡/(k_B T)). The molar form calls PhysJS.Arrhenius.arrhenius_eq at R = N_A k_B. The logarithmic derivative is Ea = ΔH‡ + R T. That Ea is not the constant in k = A exp(−Ea/(R T)) at A = (k_B T/h) exp(ΔS‡/R); those substitutions differ by exp(−1). The transmission coefficient is 1
